pages.text: Recycle what you do not need at a $(item)Salvaging Table$(). Class weapons, armor, quivers and jewelry give back part of their materials; relics give rarity materials by grade; gear with a rarity also gives its rarity material. Unique weapons always have a rarity. Spell books, scrolls, song sheets and upgrade crystals cannot be recycled.
At a $(item)Reforging Table$(), spend a rarity material and gem dust to reroll an item's affixes at that rarity. Reforging to Rare, Epic or Mythic needs Smith level 10, 20 or 30.
